name: Masunaga Nozomi
source:
Masunaga Kazuna's older brother. Ever since moving to Tokyo, he hasn't been in touch with his younger brother much. He is smart and competent, but fundamentally temperamental and dry. He is hard to read and elusive.

[Translated from [url=http://www.bprogame.com/member/others/#masunaganozomi]official website[/url]]
